package analytics // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/analytics"

const (
	FlushInterval = time.Minute

	Unmatched = "unmatched"

	Other = "other"
)

const RetentionDays = 90

const RouteLimit = 5

const Slower = time.Duration(math.MaxInt64)

func ForgetMember(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, member string) error

func Initialize(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, now time.Time) error

func Label(kind Kind) string

func LatencyBuckets() []time.Duration

func Maintenance(db *sql.DB, next http.Handler) http.Handler

func MemberID(id int64) string

func NumericID(raw string) string

func Prune(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, at time.Time) error

func RecordFailedSignIn(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, at time.Time) error

func RecordLogin(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, member string, at time.Time) error

func RecordRateLimited(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, at time.Time) error

func RecordRejectedToken(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, at time.Time) error

func RecordView(ctx context.Context, exec Executor, kind Kind, member, item string, at time.Time) error

func RecordViews(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, events []Event, at time.Time) error

func RemoveDetail(ctx context.Context, exec Executor) error

func Track(db *sql.DB, next http.HandlerFunc, resolve func(*http.Request) []Event) http.HandlerFunc

func WindowStart(at time.Time) time.Time

type Account struct{ ID, Name string }

type Content struct {
	Kind  Kind
	ID    string
	Views int64
}

func (c Content) Description() string

type Daily struct {
	Day time.Time

	Logins, Views int64
	Traffic
	Security
}

type Event struct {
	Kind         Kind
	Member, Item string
}

type Executor interface {
	ExecContext(context.Context, string, ...any) (sql.Result, error)
}

type Histogram [len(latencyBounds) + 1]int64

func (h Histogram) Count() int64

func (h *Histogram) Observe(elapsed time.Duration)

func (h Histogram) Percentile(p float64) (upper time.Duration, ok bool)

type Kind string

const (
	Video          Kind = "video"
	Post           Kind = "post"
	Image          Kind = "image"
	Recommendation Kind = "recommendation"
	Story          Kind = "story"
	Topic          Kind = "topic"
)

type Login struct {
	Name  string
	Count int64
	Last  time.Time
}

type Monitor struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func NewMonitor(db *sql.DB) *Monitor

func (m *Monitor) Flush(ctx context.Context) error

func (m *Monitor) Middleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler

type Route struct {
	Pattern string
	Traffic
}

type Security struct {
	FailedSignIns, RateLimited, RejectedTokens int64
}

type Summary struct {
	Started time.Time

	Logins, ActiveMembers, Views int64
	Traffic
	Security
	Days []Daily

	Slowest, Failing []Route

	LoginsByAccount []Login

	Popular []Content
}

func Collect(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, accountsQuery string, now time.Time) (Summary, error)

type Traffic struct {
	Requests                                   int64
	Status2xx, Status3xx, Status4xx, Status5xx int64
	Bytes                                      int64
	Latency                                    Histogram
}

func (t Traffic) ErrorRate() float64
